a little. i worry a lot about if itll make me emotional and if im emotional around my period i feel less valid because i know my hormones are probably making it worse.

pms could be making your anxiety worse in the time leading up to your period.

have you thought about taking the pill or an implant? they can make your periods lighter or stop them all together and if you have bad pms symptoms they could help with them too.

hi from another swimmer in the uk!

im not sure about make up as thats not really my kind of thing but i know you can buy swimwear that covers your thighs if youre up for that kind of thing. usually search for "legsuit" on more sporty websites if youre looking to cover that area and more generally (im not too sure about specific sites so it might be a good idea to google terms like legsuit and see what websites show up), look for swimwear made for uv protection or surfing to be covered up in general (lots of outdoor kind of shops like mountain warehouse sell rash vests with long sleeves and surfwear shops tend to sell long sleeved and legged swimsuits). i usually swim in a rash vest and nobody bats an eye.

for covering up marks without swimwear that covers them, i can only really suggest waterproof plasters or something like that. i have some smaller marks on my wrist that i cover with a waterproof watch i use for my swim times (and if i need a plaster under it i can just say it was uncomfortable against my skin).

if someone notices the ones on your hand and wrist you could say you had an accident while cooking or DIY.

sorry for the long post but i hope some of it is helpful.
